    static int[] analyzeDocument(String document) {
        boolean inParentheses = false;
        boolean lastWasLetter = false;
        int maxWordLength = 0;
        int currentWordLength = 0;
        int parenthesesWordCount = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < document.length(); i++) {
            char ch = document.charAt(i);
            if (ch == '(') {
                inParentheses = true;
                lastWasLetter = false;
                currentWordLength = 0;
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                inParentheses = false;
                lastWasLetter = false;
                currentWordLength = 0;
            } else if (Character.isLetter(ch)) {
                if (inParentheses && !lastWasLetter) {
                    parenthesesWordCount++;
                } else if (!inParentheses) {
                    currentWordLength++;
                    maxWordLength = Math.max(maxWordLength, currentWordLength);
                }
                lastWasLetter = true;
            } else {
                lastWasLetter = false;
                currentWordLength = 0;
            }
        }
        return new int[]{maxWordLength, parenthesesWordCount};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int length = scanner.nextInt();
        String document = scanner.next();
        int[] result = analyzeDocument(document);
        System.out.println(result[0] + " " + result[1]);
    }
}
